lawyer:
Shawkat Ali Khan, with Fazlul Huq Khan Farid, Tomizuddin Ahmed and Khurshid Alam Khan, Advocates ------ For the Condemned Prisoners- Appellants. 
Amirul Kabir Chowdhury Deputy Attorney-General with Abdus Salam Mamun, Assistant Attorney-General ------ For the State.

full_judgment:
Md. Ansar Ali J: This Criminal Reference No. 41 of 1991 under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been forwarded to this Court by the learned Special Tribunal No. 16 Dhaka for the confirmation of the sentence of death by hanging passed on 5 appellants-condemned prisoners namely, 1) Raja Abdul Majid, 2) Nawab Khan 3) Md. Abdullah, 4) Sadullah Khan and 5) Washim Aslam of Pakistan in Special Tribunal Case No.121 of 1987 under section 25B(1) of the Special Powers Act 1974 for committing the offence of smuggling heroin in Bangladesh vide judgment and other dated 1.10.91. In the same case by the same judgment other 2 co-accused namely, 1) Abdul Mazid Anowar of Pakistan and Mirza Abdul Quddus alias Babul of Bangladesh have been convicted under section 25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 14 years each and also to pay a fine of Taka 5,000.00 each, in default to suffer R/I for 3(three) months more and against the said judgment and order of conviction and sentence all the 7 convicts have preferred Jail Appeal No. 1877 of 1991 and they have also collectively filed a regular appeal being Criminal Appeal No. 1991. As the death reference as well as the other 2 appeals have arisen out of the same impugned judgment and order, we have heard those together and the same are being disposed of by the following one judgment after some delay due to illness of one of us. 

 2. The prosecution case, in short, is, that on 11-10-1986 at 17.30 hours one Mokbul Hossain, Inspector of Police, Detective Branch, Dhaka Metropolitan Police, Dhaka lodged a written First Information Report with the Ramna Police Station alleging, inter alia, that he received a secret information to the effect that a huge quantity of heroin brought from Pakistan by some members of an International Smuggling Gang was going to be sold through one Abdul Quader of Dhanmondi College Street. Then the informant PW 1 along with other Police force namely, Asstt. Police Commissioner Mr. F Karim Khan, Police Inspector Sultan Ahmed, SI Saifur Rahman, Abdul Khaleque, etc. went to the house of accused Abdul Quader on 11-10-86 at 11-00 AM and arrested him from the College Street, Dhanmondi, Dhaka and on interrogation he informed the Police that he had other accomplice namely, accused Mirza Abdul Quddus @ Babul who was staying in the Hotel Titas at New Circular Road, Dhaka. The informant then along with his force went to that Hotel Titas and arrested accused Mirza Abdul Quddus from room No.137 of the said Hotel who on interrogation confessed that he had one Kilogram of heroin in room No. 143 with him given by some Pakistanis for sale and then being asked he brought out that quantity of heroin kept in a packet in a brief-case in presence of witnesses namely, one Md. Abdul Jalil, Shamsul Islam, etc. He also disclosed that 5 other Pakistani co-accused’s were staying in the Hotel Chand at Maghbazar, Dhaka with some more heroin. The informant PW 1 along with his force then went to the Hotel Chand and arrested Pakistani accused Raja Abdul Majid, Nowab Khan, Md. Abdullah and Sadullah Khan from room No.6 of the said hotel and accused Wasim Aslam from room No. 4 of the said hotel. On interrogation they admitted that they had heroin with them and being asked they then jointly in presence of witnesses handed over 2 packets of heroin which were kept in room No.3 of the said hotel within a polythene bag and accordingly seizure list was prepared. The said Pakistani accused’s further stated to the Police that they had another accomplice named Abdul Mazid Anowar who was staying in the house of the accused Mirza Abdul Quddus @ Babul at Tejgaon. The informant along with his force then went to the house of the said Mirza Abdul Quddus @ Babul at L/4, BG Press Staff Quarter Tejgaon, Dhaka and arrested therefrom accused Abdul Mazid Anwar and recovered a brief-case therefrom with some heroin. It was stated in the First Information Report that the recovered total quantity of heroin would be worth more than Taka 1 (one) crore and 20 (twenty) lac. All the 8 accused persons were thus arrested and the aforesaid quantity of heroin was seized in presence of witnesses and seizure-lists were accordingly prepared. Thereafter, the informant lodged the First Information Report with the Ramna Police Station and Ramna Police Station Case No.21 dated 11-10-1986 under section 14 of the Dangerous Drugs Act and under section 156(8) of the Customs Act read with the Special Powers Act, 1974 was started against all the accused’s. DMP Inspector the informant himself took up the investigation of the case, visited the place of occurrence, examined witnesses under section 161 CrPC. Meanwhile the accused persons were taken in the Police custody on remand after their first production before the CMM Dhaka on 12-10-1986. The Police again produced them before the Metropolitan Magistrate Dhaka on 18-10-86 and 19-10-86 when their confessional statements under section 164 CrPC were recorded. Meanwhile PW 12 Md. Younus Ali Talukder SI of Police was given the charge of the rest of the investigation of the case from 2-11-86 who again visited the place of occurrence, examined some witnesses under section 161 CrPC and after consultation of the case-diary completed the investigation of the case and submitted charge-sheet on 4-3-1987 against all the accused persons under section 14 of the Drugs Act 1930 and under section 156(8) of the Customs Act and 25B of the Special Powers Act 1974. Meanwhile a sample of the seized heroin was sent to the chemical examiner at Mohakhali Dhaka to test whether the same contained actual heroin and after test the report came to the effect that the same contained actual heroin. The case record was then sent up to the Special Tribunal Dhaka for trial and the same was registered as Special Tribunal Case No. 121 of 1987 and thereafter charge was framed after hearing both the sides by the learned Special Tribunal as against all the accused persons under section 25B of the Special Powers Act 1974 to which they pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried according to law. The prosecution in all examined 8 PWs including the informant PW 1, the investigating officer PW 12, the chemical examiner PW 13 and PW 11 the Magistrate who recorded the 164 statement of the accused’s and tendered 5 witnesses namely, PWs. 2, 4, 7, 8 and 9. The defence did not examine any witness, but from the trend of cross-examination of the PWs and the statement of the accused’s under section 342 CrPC, the defence plea appears to be of innocence and false implication. Further individual defence of accused A. Quader was that he was arrested by the Police from Sutrapur Bazar of Dhaka on 11-10-86 at 9-00 AM on suspicion and brought to the DB Office where he was severely tortured to make a confessional statement though he was not aware of any seizure of heroin. The defence of accused A. Quddus was that he was innocent and he was arrested from Mouchak Market and brought to his house at BG Press Quarter, Dhaka and that no heroin was recovered from his possession and that Police wrongly arrested his Pakistani friend accused A. Mazid Anwar from his house who came to Bangladesh from Pakistan in connection with Tablig work but he was physically tortured severely by the Police and forced to make a confessional statement against his will; that he was not a boarder of the Hotel Titas and he had no heroin with him for sale as alleged. Further, accused A. Quader and the other accused persons of this case were not known to him and no heroin was recovered from his possession. The defence of accused Md. Abdullah, Sadullah Khan, Nawab Khan, Raza Abdul Majid and Wasim Aslam was, inter alia, that they procured visa for Bangkok but they were informed that their plane fare will be cheap if they would go to Bangkok via Dhaka and accordingly they arrived at the Dhaka Airport by the PIA on 8.10.86 and hired a baby-taxi and asked the driver of the same to take them to a good hotel when the driver of the Taxi brought them to hotel Chand of Mogbazar and accordingly they, rented room Nos A and 6 only of the said hotel but on 11-10-86 when they were sitting and gossiping together in room No.6 of the said hotel, a group of Police force suddenly entered into their room and arrested them all. Thereafter they were subjected to various kinds of inhuman torture and forced to sign some papers subsequently disclosed to have contained confessions to the effect that they were in possession of heroin but, in fact, heroin was unknown to them and that no heroin was recovered from their possession. It was however alleged that they were first brought to the DB office and then were given electric shock, hot water spray and severely tortured in different ways to make confessions of guilt and subsequently produced before a Magistrate and asked to sign some papers but they still refused to do so. Then they were again taken back to the Police custody on remand and again brutally tortured and ultimately forced to sign some papers against their will which now appear to have been used as their confessional statements. Defence case of accused A Majid was that he came to Bangladesh in connection with Tablig Jamat. He also came to Bangladesh earlier for the same purpose, that his four brothers were Imams of different Mosques in Pakistan; that he was innocent and he had no knowledge of the alleged heroin and that he was forced to sign a paper which subsequently appears to have been used as confessional statement after servere torture. Sum and substance of the defence case was that the accused’s were innocent and they were not smugglers and no heroin was recovered from their possession as alleged. 

 19. PW 10 is SI Md. Abdul Khaleque, He stated that on 11-10-86 he received an information to the effect that smugglers had come from Pakistan to sell out heroin through one Abdul Quader and on receipt of that information he along with PW 1 Police Inspector Maqbul Hossain and some others arrested the said A. Quader at the College Steet Road, Dhanmondi when on interrogation, the said accused Quader informed him about the possession of heroin by accused A Quddus who was staying in the Hotel Titas and then they all rushed to the said hotel and arrested accused A. Quddus from Room No. 137 when A. Quddus on interrogation stated that he had one KG of heroin kept in room No. 143 of that hotel. Then according to this showing the said one KG of heroin was recovered and seized from that room and a seizure-list was accordingly prepared in presence of witnesses. Then on further interrogation accused Quddus stated that some 5 other Pakistani accuseds were residing in the Hotel Chand of Mogbazar with heroin and thereafter they all proceeded to that Hotel Chand and arrested accused A. Majid, Nawab Khan, Sadulla and Abdullah from Room No. 6 and accused Wasim Aslam from Room No. 4 of the said Hotel. On interrogation, they admitted that they had heroin with them kept in Room No. 3 which was ultimately recovered by the Police in presence of witnesses. On further interrogation the accuseds disclosed that another Pakistani citizen A. Majid Anowar was residing in the house of accused A. Quddus at BG Press Quarter, Tejgaon, Dhaka. The Police then proceeded to that place and arrested A. Majid Anowar from the house of accused A. Quddus and from his possession also this witness PW 10 A Khaleque recovered 8 small packets of heroin along with the passport of accused A. Majid Anowar and prepared a seizure-list in presence of witnesses and he proved the seizure-list. He also identified accused A. Quddus and A. Majid Anowar on the dock.
